title: splatter cone for 12" pans
text: splatter cone for 12" pans. If you like to saute large tubs of spinach or other greens, you need this cone.  Dump the whole tub in - and saute.  Mind blown.  I guess you could use a grease splatter screen.. I don't fry much.  It can go right into the dishwasher.  Once you try this, you'll never go back!

product_metadata.title: Frywall 12 (Large) - Charcoal - Splatter Guard, as Seen on Shark Tank
features: FRYWALL 12" IS BIG – Verify your pan size before ordering. Frywall 12 fits 12" pans. Will not fit pans with lip-to-lip diameters smaller than 11.5". Not suitable for downdraft stoves.
NO COMPROMISE PROTECTION: Combines uninterrupted protection with complete access to cooking surface, providing all the benefits of an uncovered pan without the mess.

STOPS OIL MIST AND CONDENSATION: Completely blocks fine oil that splatter screens let through, but lets steam escape freely. So burgers sear perfectly, sauces reduce quickly, and condensation splatter is eliminated.
SPILLOVER STOPPER: Perfect for preventing spillovers when sautéing lots of veggies and greens in overfull pan.

SAFE, CLEAN AND COMPACT: Made of BPA-free, FDA-compliant silicone that can withstand sustained temperatures of up to 450°F. Dishwasher safe and easy to clean. After use rolls into cup-sized sleeve for compact storage.
